# Acadlytic, Inc.

> AI-powered EdTech CRM & Cloud Platform for Academic Management. Where Education Meets Intelligence.

Acadlytic, Inc. is building an AI-powered EdTech CRM and cloud platform for academic management, designed to connect admissions and CRM, student records, academic operations, finance and fees, communication, documents and analytics, with AI features that keep people in control of consequential decisions.

Status: the platform is in development. Product, AI, solution and integration pages describe planned capabilities that are not yet generally available. Acadlytic publishes no customer counts, testimonials or certifications.

- Website: https://acadlytic.com/
- Contact: info@acadlytic.com
- Request a demo: https://acadlytic.com/company/request-demo/
- Official profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/acadlytic, https://x.com/acadlytic, https://www.youtube.com/@acadlytic, https://www.instagram.com/acadlytic/, https://www.facebook.com/acadlytic/

## Platform

- [Academic Management](https://acadlytic.com/core/academic-management/): (Planned) Cloud academic management software that unifies admissions, student records, academic operations, finance and reporting for colleges and universities.
- [EdTech CRM](https://acadlytic.com/core/edtech-crm/): (Planned) An EdTech CRM designed for education: manage enquiries, applicants, students, parents, alumni and partners as lifelong relationships on one cloud platform.
- [Cloud Platform](https://acadlytic.com/core/cloud-platform/): (Planned) Acadlytic is being built as a cloud platform for academic management: browser-based access, managed updates, scalable infrastructure and security by design.
- [Pricing](https://acadlytic.com/core/pricing/): How Acadlytic pricing works: what shapes a quote for your institution, which modules are included and how to get a proposal tailored to your size and scope.
- [Platform](https://acadlytic.com/platform/): (Planned) Explore the Acadlytic platform: admissions and CRM, student management, academic operations, finance, communication, analytics and documents on one cloud data model.
- [Admissions & CRM](https://acadlytic.com/platform/admissions-crm/): (Planned) Admissions CRM for colleges and universities: capture enquiries from every channel, automate follow-ups, track applications and convert applicants to enrolments.
- [Student Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/student-management/): (Planned) Acadlytic’s planned student management: one accurate record per student covering profile, programme, documents, attendance, results, fees and communication.
- [Student Lifecycle](https://acadlytic.com/platform/student-lifecycle/): (Planned) Manage the full student lifecycle, from enquiry and admission to progression, completion and alumni, with defined stages, hand-offs and visibility across teams.
- [Application Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/application-management/): (Planned) Track every application from start to decision: online forms, document checklists, review workflows, offers and acceptance, with full visibility for applicants and staff.
- [College Recommendations](https://acadlytic.com/platform/college-recommendations/): (Planned) Help students and counsellors shortlist colleges and programmes that fit academic profile, interests, budget and location, with transparent matching criteria.
- [Post-Secondary Database](https://acadlytic.com/platform/post-secondary-school-database/): (Planned) A structured database of colleges, universities and programmes that counsellors and students can search and compare by location, requirements, cost and study mode.
- [Academic Operations](https://acadlytic.com/platform/academic-operations/): (Planned) Run academic operations in one system: academic calendars, timetables, attendance, assessments, results and course administration for colleges and universities.
- [Finance & Fees](https://acadlytic.com/platform/finance-fees/): (Planned) Manage fee structures, invoices, instalments, concessions, online payments and reconciliation, connected to student records and communication.
- [Communication Hub](https://acadlytic.com/platform/communication-hub/): (Planned) Message students, parents, applicants and staff by email, SMS and WhatsApp, with templates, consent management, scheduling and a full history on every record.
- [Document Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/electronic-document-sharing/): (Planned) Collect, verify, store and share academic documents securely: application documents, certificates, transcripts and requests, with permissions and an audit trail.
- [Completion Tracking](https://acadlytic.com/platform/completion-tracking/): (Planned) Track every student’s progress toward completion: credits, requirements, clearances and milestones, with early alerts when someone is off track to graduate.
- [Task Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/task-management/): (Planned) Assign, track and complete institutional tasks with owners, due dates and context, generated by workflows or created by staff, across every department.
- [Analytics & AI](https://acadlytic.com/platform/reports-insights/): (Planned) Real-time reports and dashboards for admissions, academics, finance and engagement, with scheduled delivery, drill-down and AI-generated summaries.
- [Data Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/data-management/): (Planned) Keep institutional data accurate and governed: validation rules, duplicate management, data dictionaries, imports, retention and access controls on one platform.
- [Workflow Automation](https://acadlytic.com/platform/workflow-automation/): (Planned) Automate repetitive academic and administrative processes with a no-code workflow builder: triggers, conditions, approvals, tasks and notifications.
- [Institutional Dashboard](https://acadlytic.com/platform/institutional-dashboard/): (Planned) An institution-wide dashboard for leadership: admissions, enrolment, academic health, finance and engagement indicators in one role-based view, updated from live data.
- [Student Engagement](https://acadlytic.com/platform/student-engagement/): (Planned) Understand and improve student engagement with connected signals from attendance, participation, communication and services, plus timely, personalised outreach.
- [Enrolment Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/platform/enrollment-analytics/): (Planned) Analyse your enrolment funnel from enquiry to enrolled: conversion by stage, source and programme, cycle-over-cycle comparisons and forecasts for planning.

## Acadlytic AI

- [AI Assistant](https://acadlytic.com/core/ai-assistant/): (Planned) The planned Acadlytic AI Assistant is designed to answer questions about admissions, students and operations in plain language, draft messages and explain reports.
- [Acadlytic AI](https://acadlytic.com/ai/): (Planned) Acadlytic AI is designed to bring assistants, predictions, recommendations and document intelligence into academic workflows, with human approval and clear explanations.
- [AI for Admissions](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-for-admissions/): (Planned) AI for admissions teams: prioritise follow-ups, draft personalised replies, summarise applicant histories and forecast intake, with counsellors in control.
- [AI for Student Success](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-for-student-success/): (Planned) Identify students who may need support earlier with explainable early-warning signals from attendance, submissions and engagement, then coordinate timely outreach.
- [AI for Advising](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-for-advising/): (Planned) AI tools for academic advisors: meeting briefs, progress summaries, suggested next steps and follow-up drafting, so advisors spend more time with students.
- [AI Recommendations](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-recommendations/): (Planned) Next-best-action recommendations for admissions, advising and administration teams, based on institutional data and explained so staff can decide confidently.
- [AI Personalisation](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-personalization/): (Planned) Personalise communication and portal experiences for applicants and students by programme, stage, language and preferences, with consent and transparency.
- [AI Insights](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-insights/): (Planned) Planned AI insights designed to watch institutional data for unusual changes, such as sudden drops in enquiries or spikes in absences, and alert the right team.
- [AI Reporting](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-reporting/): (Planned) Planned AI reporting designed to turn dashboards into plain-language summaries for leadership, explaining what changed and what the data cannot tell you.
- [AI Workflows](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-workflows/): (Planned) Automate administrative work with AI steps inside approval-based workflows: classify, extract, draft and summarise, with confidence thresholds and a full audit log.
- [AI Search](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-search/): (Planned) Acadlytic’s planned natural-language search, designed to find people, records, documents and answers while understanding intent and respecting permissions.
- [Document Intelligence](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-document-intelligence/): (Planned) Planned AI document intelligence designed to classify uploaded documents, extract key fields and check legibility, so staff can verify faster with fewer errors.
- [Predictive Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-predictive-analytics/): (Planned) Forecast enrolment, demand and capacity with predictive analytics that show ranges, assumptions and accuracy, so planning is informed rather than overconfident.
- [AI Communications](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-communications/): (Planned) Draft clear, on-brand messages for students, parents and applicants with AI, including translation, tone adjustment and summaries, always reviewed before sending.
- [AI in Education](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-in-education/): (Planned) Where AI genuinely helps education institutions today (administration, student support and insight), where it does not, and how to adopt it responsibly.
- [Responsible AI](https://acadlytic.com/ai/responsible-ai/): (Planned) The principles and controls that govern AI in Acadlytic: human oversight, transparency, privacy, fairness monitoring, security and institutional control.

- [Parents](https://acadlytic.com/solutions/for-parents/): (Planned) Keep parents and guardians informed about attendance, results, fees and events through their preferred channel, within the student’s privacy settings.
- [Institutions](https://acadlytic.com/industries/): (Planned) How Acadlytic adapts to universities, colleges, community colleges, private and public institutions, online and lifelong learning, and multi-campus groups.
- [Community Colleges](https://acadlytic.com/industries/community-colleges/): (Planned) Acadlytic for community colleges: open-access enrolment, part-time and returning learners, workforce programmes and student support on one connected platform.
- [Private Institutions](https://acadlytic.com/industries/private-institutions/): (Planned) Acadlytic for private colleges and universities: competitive recruitment, fee-dependent operations, brand-consistent communication and fast decision cycles.

- [Continuing Education](https://acadlytic.com/industries/continuing-education/): (Planned) Acadlytic for continuing and lifelong learning: flexible enrolment, modular credentials, returning learners, stackable programmes and adult-learner communication.

- [Multi-Campus Groups](https://acadlytic.com/industries/multi-campus/): (Planned) Manage multiple campuses and institutions on one platform: shared standards, local configuration, campus-scoped access and consolidated group reporting.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/): (Planned) Connect Acadlytic with student information systems, LMS, ERP, payment gateways, single sign-on, email, WhatsApp and your own apps via APIs, webhooks and exports.
- [SIS Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/sis-integration/): (Planned) Integrate Acadlytic with your student information system to sync student records, enrolments and results, avoid duplicate entry and keep one source of truth.
- [LMS Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/lms-integration/): (Planned) Connect Acadlytic with your learning management system: provision courses and enrolments, bring back grades and activity, and use LMS signals for student support.
- [ERP Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/erp-integration/): (Planned) Integrate Acadlytic with your ERP or accounting system for fee postings, general ledger summaries, HR and staff data, while keeping student-facing finance in Acadlytic.
- [CRM Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/crm-integration/): (Planned) Connect Acadlytic with an existing enterprise CRM or marketing platform: sync contacts, campaigns and outcomes so recruitment and marketing share one picture.
- [SSO Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/sso-integration/): (Planned) Let staff and students sign in to Acadlytic with your institution’s identity provider via SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect, with centralised access and deprovisioning.
- [Payment Gateways](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/payment-integration/): (Planned) Collect application and tuition fees online through payment gateways, with automatic invoice matching, instant receipts and daily settlement reconciliation.
- [Email](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/email-integration/): (Planned) Connect Acadlytic with institutional email: send from your domain with proper authentication, log staff emails on records and keep deliverability healthy.
- [WhatsApp](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/whatsapp-integration/): (Planned) Use WhatsApp Business messaging for admissions, reminders and parent updates, with approved templates, opt-in consent and conversations logged on each record.
- [SMS & Messaging](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/messaging-integration/): (Planned) Send SMS and in-app notifications through connected providers for alerts and reminders, with sender registration, delivery reports and consent rules.
- [Calendar](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/calendar-integration/): (Planned) Sync timetables, advising appointments, interviews and events between Acadlytic and staff and student calendars, with booking links and reminders.
- [REST API](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/api/): (Planned) The planned Acadlytic REST API, designed to let institutions and partners read and write platform data securely with scoped credentials, rate limits and versioning.
- [Webhooks & Events](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/webhooks/): (Planned) Subscribe to Acadlytic events such as application submitted, student enrolled or payment received, and trigger your own systems in near real time.
- [Data Export](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/data-export/): (Planned) Export Acadlytic data on demand or on a schedule for analytics, archiving and portability, in open formats, with permissions and export logging.

- [Student Management Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/student-management-guide/): How student management software works: the student record, core processes, data quality, permissions, portals and how to evaluate a system for your institution.
- [Student Lifecycle Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/student-lifecycle-guide/): A guide to managing the student lifecycle: defining stages, owning hand-offs, measuring transitions and using data to support students from enquiry to alumni.
- [Analytics Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/academic-analytics-guide/): How education analytics supports decisions: data sources, descriptive to predictive analytics, choosing metrics, building trust in numbers and acting on insight.
- [AI in Higher Education](https://acadlytic.com/resources/ai-in-higher-education-guide/): A leadership guide to adopting AI in higher education operations: priority use cases, governance, data readiness, risk, change management and a phased roadmap.
- [Cloud Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/cloud-education-guide/): A guide to cloud computing for education institutions: SaaS vs hosting, shared responsibility, security, data residency, costs and planning a move to the cloud.
- [Automation Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/education-automation-guide/): How to decide what to automate in academic operations: finding candidates, scoring them by impact and risk, keeping human oversight and measuring results.
- [Workflow Design Example](https://acadlytic.com/resources/education-workflow-automation/): A step-by-step worked example of designing an automated education workflow, a certificate request, from process mapping to rules, exceptions and measurement.
- [Dashboard Design Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/institutional-dashboard-guide/): Design an institutional dashboard leadership will actually use: choosing indicators, definitions, comparisons, layout, ownership and review rhythms.
- [Digital Transformation](https://acadlytic.com/resources/digital-transformation-education/): What digital transformation means for education institutions, why initiatives stall, and a practical approach focused on processes, people, data and phased change.
- [Data-Driven Education](https://acadlytic.com/resources/data-driven-education/): How institutions build a data-driven culture: decision rhythms, data literacy, trustworthy numbers, ethical use and making insight part of everyday work.
- [Data Strategy](https://acadlytic.com/resources/academic-data-strategy/): Build an academic data strategy: data ownership, a shared data model, quality processes, governance roles, privacy, retention and an integration architecture.
- [Engagement Strategies](https://acadlytic.com/resources/student-engagement-strategies/): Practical student engagement strategies: onboarding, early check-ins, relevant communication, community, visible support and using engagement data well.
- [Admissions Workflow](https://acadlytic.com/resources/admissions-workflow/): Design a modern admissions workflow end to end: enquiry handling, application design, document verification, decisions, offers and the handover to enrolment.
- [AI vs Traditional](https://acadlytic.com/resources/ai-vs-traditional-management/): How AI-assisted academic management differs from traditional approaches across admissions, support, reporting and administration, and what stays the same.
- [Cloud Checklist](https://acadlytic.com/resources/education-cloud-checklist/): A checklist of security, privacy, reliability, integration and exit questions to ask before moving academic systems to a cloud or SaaS platform.
- [Evaluation Checklist](https://acadlytic.com/resources/academic-management-checklist/): An evaluation checklist for academic management software: functional fit, usability, integration, data, security, AI governance, implementation and commercial terms.
- [CRM Implementation Plan](https://acadlytic.com/resources/crm-implementation-plan/): A phased CRM implementation plan for colleges and universities: goals, team, data preparation, configuration, testing, training, go-live and the first 90 days.
- [Student Data Migration](https://acadlytic.com/resources/student-data-migration/): How to migrate student data to a new system safely: inventory, mapping, cleansing, trial loads, reconciliation, cut-over and keeping the old system read-only.
- [Education Software RFP](https://acadlytic.com/resources/education-software-rfp/): How to write an RFP or requirements document for student management, CRM or academic software: structure, must-have requirements, security questions and scoring.
- [Education Software TCO](https://acadlytic.com/resources/education-software-tco/): How to estimate the total cost of ownership of student management or CRM software: licences, implementation, integration, migration, training, support and exit.
- [Retention Strategies](https://acadlytic.com/resources/student-retention-strategies/): Practical student retention strategies for colleges: early alerts, first-year support, advising, financial help and using data without labelling students.
- [Enrolment Funnel Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/enrollment-funnel-guide/): The student enrolment funnel explained: stages from enquiry to enrolment, the conversion metrics to track at each stage and how to find where applicants drop out.
- [Fee Collection Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/fee-collection-guide/): Practical ways colleges can improve fee collection: clear fee schedules, online payments, instalments, timely reminders, reconciliation and fair handling of hardship.
- [Attendance Management Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/attendance-management-guide/): A practical guide to student attendance management: capturing attendance reliably, setting policies, following up absences early and using attendance data responsibly.
- [Accreditation Data Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/accreditation-data-guide/): How colleges can prepare data for accreditation such as NAAC and NBA: owners, definitions, evidence, outcome attainment and collecting data all year, not at the deadline.
- [Student Data Privacy Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/student-data-privacy-guide/): A practical guide to protecting student data: principles, access control, consent, retention, vendors and incidents, with an overview of India’s DPDP Act, FERPA and GDPR.
- [Exam Management Guide](https://acadlytic.com/resources/exam-management-guide/): A practical guide to exam management in colleges: scheduling, question paper security, seating, invigilation, evaluation, moderation, results and records.
- [Comparisons](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/): Side-by-side comparisons to help institutions decide: CRM vs SIS, CRM vs ERP, cloud vs on-premise, spreadsheets vs platforms, manual vs automated admissions and more.
- [Academic CRM vs SIS](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/academic-crm-vs-sis/): Academic CRM vs student information system: how they differ in purpose, data, users and timing, and whether your institution needs one, the other or both.
- [Academic CRM vs ERP](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/academic-crm-vs-erp/): Education CRM vs ERP: compare purpose, users, data and strengths, and see where each fits in an institution’s technology stack and how they work together.
- [Cloud vs On-Premise](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/cloud-vs-on-premise-education/): Compare cloud and on-premise academic software on cost, security, control, updates, scalability, connectivity and exit, and decide which suits your institution.
- [Manual vs Automated Admissions](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/manual-vs-automated-admissions/): Compare manual and automated admissions on speed, consistency, applicant experience, workload and insight, and learn what should always stay human.
- [Spreadsheets vs Platform](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/spreadsheets-vs-academic-platform/): Spreadsheets vs an academic platform or CRM: compare data integrity, collaboration, security, automation and reporting, and know when it is time to move.
- [Point Solutions vs Platform](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/point-solutions-vs-platform/): Compare best-of-breed point solutions with a unified academic platform on integration effort, data consistency, user experience, cost and flexibility.
- [AI vs Manual Reporting](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/ai-reporting-vs-manual-reporting/): Compare AI-assisted reporting with manual reporting on speed, consistency, depth, accuracy risks and effort, and see how to combine them safely.
- [SIS vs LMS](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/sis-vs-lms/): SIS vs LMS explained: what a student information system and a learning management system each do, the data they own, who uses them and how they should connect.
- [ERP vs SIS](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/erp-vs-sis/): ERP vs SIS for education institutions: how an enterprise resource planning system differs from a student information system, where they overlap and how to decide.
- [CRM vs LMS](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/crm-vs-lms/): CRM vs LMS in education: how a CRM that manages enquiries and engagement differs from a learning management system for teaching, and how the two can work together.
- [Education CRM vs general CRM](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/general-crm-vs-education-crm/): Should a college use a general-purpose sales CRM or an education-specific CRM? A factual comparison of data models, workflows, consent, integration and total effort.
- [Build vs buy](https://acadlytic.com/comparisons/build-vs-buy-education-software/): Should an institution build its own student management or CRM software, or buy a product? The costs, risks and conditions that favour each option, without the hype.

## Optional

- [Glossary](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/): Plain-language definitions of academic technology terms: academic CRM, SIS, ERP, education analytics, student lifecycle, SSO, education cloud and more.
- [Academic CRM](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/academic-crm/): Academic CRM definition: software that manages an institution’s relationships with prospective students, applicants, students, parents and alumni across the lifecycle.
- [Admissions CRM](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/admissions-crm/): Admissions CRM definition: software that helps admissions teams capture enquiries, follow up, track applications and measure conversion to enrolment.
- [Student Information System](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/student-information-system/): Student information system definition: the system of record for student data such as enrolment, courses, grades, attendance and credentials at an institution.
- [Academic ERP](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/academic-erp/): Academic ERP definition: enterprise resource planning adapted for institutions, covering finance, HR, procurement and often student administration in one suite.
- [Student Lifecycle Management](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/student-lifecycle-management/): Student lifecycle management definition: coordinating every stage of a learner’s journey from enquiry and admission through study and completion to alumni.
- [Education Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/education-analytics/): Education analytics definition: collecting and analysing data about students, programmes and operations to inform decisions, from descriptive reports to predictions.
- [Learning Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/learning-analytics/): Learning analytics definition: measuring and analysing data about learners and their contexts to understand and improve learning and learning environments.
- [Institutional Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/institutional-analytics/): Institutional analytics definition: using operational, financial and student data to inform strategy, planning and performance management at institution level.
- [Academic Operations](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/academic-operations/): Academic operations definition: the day-to-day processes that run teaching and assessment, including calendars, timetables, attendance, exams and results.
- [Admissions Management](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/admissions-management/): Admissions management definition: the end-to-end process of recruiting, assessing and admitting students, from enquiry through application, decision and enrolment.
- [Student Success](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/student-success/): Student success definition: students achieving their educational goals, and the institutional practices, support and data used to help them get there.
- [Student Engagement](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/student-engagement/): Student engagement definition: the degree of involvement students show in their learning and institutional life, and how institutions observe and support it.
- [Workflow Automation](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/workflow-automation/): Workflow automation definition: using software to run repeatable institutional processes (triggers, rules, tasks, approvals and notifications) with minimal manual effort.
- [Education Cloud](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/education-cloud/): Education cloud definition: cloud-hosted software and infrastructure that institutions use to run academic and administrative systems as a managed service.
- [Education API](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/education-api/): Education API definition: an application programming interface that lets education systems exchange data securely, such as student, course or payment information.
- [Single Sign-On](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/single-sign-on/): Single sign-on definition: an authentication method that lets users access multiple systems with one set of institutional credentials, managed centrally.
- [Electronic Document Management](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/electronic-document-management/): Electronic document management definition: capturing, storing, organising, securing and sharing documents digitally with version control and access rules.
- [Learning Management System](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/learning-management-system/): Learning management system (LMS) definition: software for delivering course content, assignments, quizzes and discussion, and how an LMS differs from an SIS or CRM.
- [Enrolment Management](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/enrollment-management/): Enrolment management definition: the coordinated planning of recruitment, admissions, financial aid and retention so an institution meets its enrolment goals.
- [Student Retention](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/student-retention/): Student retention definition: the share of students who continue into the next period of study, how the rate is calculated and how it differs from persistence.
- [Role-Based Access Control](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/role-based-access-control/): Role-based access control (RBAC) definition: granting permissions through roles rather than to individuals, and why it matters for student data in education software.
- [Lead Scoring](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/lead-scoring/): Lead scoring definition for admissions: ranking enquiries by fit and engagement so counsellors know whom to contact first, with the risks to watch.
- [Outcome-Based Education](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/outcome-based-education/): Outcome-based education (OBE) definition: designing curriculum, teaching and assessment around defined outcomes, with program outcomes, course outcomes and attainment.
- [Choice-Based Credit System](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/choice-based-credit-system/): Choice-based credit system (CBCS) definition: the semester and credit framework used in Indian higher education, with course types, credits, SGPA and CGPA explained.
- [Yield Rate](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/yield-rate/): Admissions yield rate definition: the share of admitted applicants who go on to enrol, how it is calculated and how institutions try to improve it.
